releases.body: Fate Labs Estelle now runs in Gemini CLI and Google Antigravity (app and agy CLI), with memory on every prompt, session capture, all 26 skills, the slash commands and Estelle's agents. One browser sign-in (/estelle:login) now covers memory and capture on every host. Helper-agent tracking and Estelle's agents reach Cursor, Kimi, Qwen and Grok; OpenClaw gets a native plugin; fx gets the agents; mini-swe-agent redacts private text. Codex, Cursor and Grok keep working with an existing key.
Faster memory on every prompt: the hook now sends the prompt's memory recall before it does its capture work, so a busy turn no longer pushes recall past its deadline. No setting changes.

Memory your agents actually get: every prompt now asks Estelle for up to 5 relevant memories (dated, with their source) and injects them; a <private>...</private> span keeps text out of capture and recall; wider secret redaction; repo identity from any remote. Subagents are supervised: a stalled or failing subagent is reported to the main agent with its next moves, a Stop with children still running says so, and subagents get the same Estelle context and their own identity. A stale install now says it is behind and how to update. Kimi Code 2.6 turns are captured again.

Subagents show in Estelle the moment they start and end on their own stop, in every host that has subagents: Claude Code and Codex mirror each subagent's steps under its parent; Cursor, Grok, Qwen and Kimi post each subagent's start, result and end. Fixes a test fixture that aged out on its own (the clock is now passed in).
Estelle now installs in Qwen Code, Hermes Agent, mini-swe-agent, OpenClaw and fx. Each host's setup guide is in docs/install/ and at estelle.fatelabs.ca/docs.
